annotations.title: Purchase costs of a home in Spain

description: Taxes and fees of buying a home in Spain: VAT + stamp duty (AJD) for a new build or transfer tax (ITP) for a resale at the general rate of the tax territory, plus notary and land registry by the official scales. Every line cites its law, article and the date it was checked. An estimate, not tax advice.

locale.description: Language of names and page links; default en.

mortgage_eur.description: Loan amount, optional: in Spain the lender pays the mortgage AJD, notary and registration (Ley 5/2019).

new_build.description: true — first sale by the developer (VAT + stamp duty AJD); false — resale (transfer tax ITP).

place.description: Where the property is in Spain: municipality or province name, 5-digit INE code of the municipality or 2-digit province code; 'province/municipality' or a 'municipio:' / 'provincia:' prefix to disambiguate.

price_eur.description: Price in whole euros WITHOUT VAT (new build) or the deed price (resale): taxes are computed on it.
